title: At the bottom of a vertical circle
caption: At the lowest point the string must supply the weight and the centripetal force: T = mg + mv²/r = 1.96 + 9.8 = 11.8 N. The net force, 9.8 N, points up to the centre.
alt: Free-body diagram of the ball at the bottom: tension 11.8 newtons up, weight 1.96 newtons down, net 9.8 newtons up towards the centre.
description: v at the top is √(gr) = 2.21 m s⁻¹, the slowest that keeps the string taut.
Falling 2r = 1.0 m adds 2g(2r): v² at the bottom = 4.9 + 19.6 = 24.5 m² s⁻².
